summary: First-run E2E testing of KrunchMate DTC landing page. Backend (/api/health, /api/subscribe) fully working; frontend flows (hero palette switch, cart drawer + fill widget, bundles, shop packs, contact form, FAQ, footer newsletter, mobile sticky bar, self-hosted fonts, British English) all pass. One functional discrepancy identified: Shop page displays discounted prices for 3× and 6× packs but the cart does not actually apply the discount (it charges full unit price × qty).

ui_bugs.issue: Multi-pack discount (5% for 3×, 10% for 6×) is displayed in the price label on the Shop page (£10.69 shown for 3×) but the cart adds the full unit price × qty (£11.25). The discount is decorative-only — customers see one price, cart charges another. addItem(flavour.id, totalPouches) needs to pass a discounted unit price OR the cart line must accept a lineTotal override.

issues: '[PLACEHOLDER — confirm KrunchMate team's live contact address.]' text is visible in production copy — this internal note should be removed or hidden before ship.
'[PLACEHOLDER — additional pouch angles needed for full 360° rotation]' internal note is visible at the bottom of the Shop grid.

action_items: Fix Shop multi-pack pricing: cart must honour the displayed discounted price for 3× (5% off) and 6× (10% off) packs. Either compute the effective unit price and add multiple line entries, or extend CartContext to accept a per-line unit price override.
Remove or gate behind an env flag the two visible '[PLACEHOLDER — …]' notes on /shop and /contact before production.
critical_code_review_comments: CartContext stores only {id, qty} → cannot represent bundle-discounted units. The Shop page computes lineTotal locally but discards it when calling addItem(id, totalPouches), causing the price mismatch described above. Suggest storing {id, qty, unitPrice?} in cart items.

Contact form: browser HTML5 required attribute on <input type='email'> may pre-empt custom validation for bad email; the JS error path is only reachable when message.length < 5. Consider stripping 'required' or move validation server-side. Not a critical bug for a frontend-only build.
Footer newsletter Fetch: no request timeout/AbortController — if backend hangs, spinner sticks on 'Sending'. Consider adding a 10s timeout.
index.css does not declare a @font-face for HopsAndBarley/RustyHooks fallback weights; only Regular is registered — matches spec but noting for future.
FlavourContext directly mutates document.body via setAttribute — this is fine but could conflict with SSR if ever adopted. Acceptable for CRA/frontend-only build.
Contact.jsx has [PLACEHOLDER] copy leaking into rendered output; Shop.jsx same issue — must be removed before launch.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only two endpoints (/api/health, /api/subscribe). pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_krunchmate_api.py is stable. On the frontend, the only material bug is the Shop pack discount not propagating to the cart — verify subtotal after clicking shop-add-* buttons matches the £X.XX shown next to the qty selector. Cart is intentionally non-persistent (resets on refresh). Contact form is intentionally frontend-only (no /api/contact endpoint). Self-hosted fonts confirmed working (FuturaBkBT, BethEllen); no Google Fonts CDN calls. British English confirmed (flavour/colour present, no American variants).
rca of the issue: Shop discount mismatch — Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/Shop.jsx computes `lineTotal = flavour.price * totalPouches * unitDiscount` for the price display, but calls `addItem(flavour.id, totalPouches)` which passes only quantity. In /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.jsx, `lineTotal` is derived as `FLAVOURS[it.id].price * it.qty` — the discount factor is lost. Fix: extend the cart item schema to `{id, qty, unitPrice}` (or add a `discountedUnitPrice` field) and update `detailed` accumulator to use it when present. Reproduction: /shop → click shop-pack-salt-vinegar-3 → click shop-add-salt-vinegar → observe drawer subtotal £11.25 while page label showed £10.69.
